entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-11-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Dropdown in "Move Static Members To Another Type" dialog has unreadable entries #81118
  • C# parser does not parse base type list of enums well if there are additional tokens #81117
  • Exception in `CSharpMoveStaticMembersRefactoringProvider` #81116
  • "Convert to conditional expression" has excessive leading whitespace when using Tab characters #81115
  • Tooltip on attribute usage shows "(+ 1 overload)" after class name #81114
  • "Simplify member access" not offered after cast expression to function pointer type #81113
  • highlighting code plus an abandoned »End If« creates an error in Visual Studio in ExtractMethodCodeRefactoringProvider #81112
  • Source link navigates to the wrong symbol #81111
  • C# can not open source link by pressing F12 #81110
  • Build fails - Error List doesn't show error #81109
  • Error List is empty even if errors occur during Build #81108
  • Unexpected nullable warning in object initializer member using extension Add method #81102
  • Allow us to translate documentation comment contents in IntelliSense written in English by GitHub Copilot #81100

Closed

  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11207.159 #81107

PullRequests

Created

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81106
    Area-Compilers, VSCode
  • Simplify sequence point display #81104
    Area-Compilers
  • Fix nullable warning for implicit extension member access in collection initializers #81103
  • Add a couple of misc runtime async tests #81101
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async

Merged

  • Don't emit DebuggerStepThroughAttribute for runtime async methods #81035
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Runtime Async, Next

Updated

  • Add IOp support for `with(...)` elements. #81058
    Area-Compilers, Needs UX Triage, Needs API Review, VSCode, Feature - Collection Arguments
  • Unskip tests of MSBuildWorkspace with blazor and blazorwasm templates #80468
    Area-IDE, VSCode
